jobs.title: Account Manager (Zurich)
jobs.description:
LumApps is now more than just an Employee Experience Platform — it is an AI-powered Employee Hub that supports companies in their digital transformation of communication, collaboration, and engagement with their customers, partners, and above all their employees.
 Our platform is a proven leader in this dynamic market with a truly unique vision and product. It has been deployed by Fortune 500 clients around the world and is delivering meaningful business benefits. LumApps is identified as a leader in Gartner's Magic Quadrant for Intranet Packaged Solutions as well as in Intranets Forrester Wave, and regularly selected for the French Tech Next40/120 program.
 ✨ In 2025, LumApps strengthened its leadership position by partnering with Beekeeper , a pioneer in frontline employee experience solutions. This strategic collaboration expands our reach and impact across all types of workers — from HQ to the frontline.
 Our mission: To make people feel that they belong and have a purpose.
 To create an environment where all employees are engaged and work together towards the same goal. Over 700 leading companies trust our solution to:
 🎯 Improve the productivity of their teams with our AI-powered Collaborative Experience Platform integrated with both Google and Microsoft collaborative suites,
 🎯 Transform employees into real ambassadors of their company,
 🎯 Make employees more efficient and better connected to their peers and relevant information, regardless of their location, with the tools and information they need at their fingertips,
 🎯 Help companies reduce turnover, accelerate employee onboarding, better collaborate and share knowledge, and even improve their customer experiences.
 With a team of over 600 Lumies spread across 11 offices (Lyon, Paris, Lille, Sophia Antipolis, London, Barcelona, Hamburg, Austin, Tokyo, Zurich, Krakow), we support large enterprises all around the world. Over the past year, we have been driving an ambitious phase in our journey under the impulse of our new shareholder Bridgepoint, aimed at propelling us to become the clear leader in our market and shine worldwide in our industry. We are looking for individuals who are excited to actively participate in this transformation.

If these core values sound like you: "be bold, do amazing things" , "say what you mean, do what you say" , "one team, same mission" , "always be evolving" : apply now!

*Team*
 The Account Manager is equal parts relationship management, sales, and client satisfaction. You will be responsible for owning a portfolio of accounts, executing renewals contracts, and upsell opportunities. We believe that keeping our existing customers is equally as important as acquiring new ones. This role will manage an assigned set of customers with a focus on maintaining and growing renewal rates and establishing relationships with a focus on retention and identification of upsell and expansion opportunities. You will work with the Customer Success teams to identify growth opportunities and provide insights that improve future outcomes. You not only ensure our customers are set up for success, but also maximize the total revenue.

Your ability to clearly articulate our value proposition, sustain and renew subscriptions, resolve customer issues/problems, and effectively manage your time will be well rewarded.

*Missions*

• Own the renewals process and collaborate with internal resources (Customer Success, Account Executives, Sales Ops…) to develop comprehensive 'win' strategies for renewals

• Develop and execute negotiation strategies for medium and large account renewals that maximize contract value while protecting and enhancing customer trust

• Identify customer requirements, uncover roadblocks, and demonstrate strong account management and commercial capabilities to drive renewal to on-time closure

• Develop innovative ways to retain escalated clients and provide them with viable renewal options, including but not limited to negotiating pricing and/or contract duration

• Identify cross-sell/up-sell opportunities and make them happen

• Responsible for creation of renewal order forms and proposals

• Leverage Salesforce, Planhat & Clari to maintain an accurate pipeline and foreca st

*Skills*

• Experience in sales, account management, or account expansion

• Native German and fluent in English

• A minimum of 3+ years of relevant SaaS work experience

• Strong business acumen and ability to analyze data to address customer situations

• Excellent communication/presentation skills and ability to build relationships

• Organizational and time-management skills

• Self-starter, eager to learn and not afraid to seek out expertise of others around you to adapt and perfect your work. Flexibility to work independently and within a team environment

• Knowledge of market research and negotiating principl es

*Bonus Points*

• Experience in a high growth company

• Bachelor degree in Economics, Marketing, or simil ar

💡 Why You’ll Love Working at LumApps
 We’re proud to offer a work environment where people feel supported, valued, and empowered. Here’s a peek at what we offer:
 🏡 Hybrid work model – 2 to 3 days at the office
 🕒 25 days of annual leave
 🛡️ Pension scheme plan with 3 options to choose from
 🎉 Afterworks, team celebrations & seasonal parties
 💻 Equipment

We aim to celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

LumApps è ora più di una semplice piattaforma Employee Experience – è un hub per i dipendenti che supporta le aziende nella loro trasformazione digitale di comunicazione, collaborazione e impegno con i loro clienti, partner, e soprattutto i loro dipendenti. La nostra piattaforma è un leader collaudato in questo mercato dinamico con una visione e un prodotto davvero unico. E 'stato distribuito da Fortune 500 clienti in tutto il mondo e sta fornendo benefici aziendali significativi. LumApps è identificato come leader nel Magic Quadrant di Gartner per le soluzioni pacchetti Intranet così come in Intranets Forrester Wave, e regolarmente selezionato per il programma francese Tech Next40/120. Nel 2025, LumApps rafforza la sua posizione di leadership collaborando con Beekeeper , pioniere nelle soluzioni di esperienza dei dipendenti di prima linea. Questa collaborazione strategica espande la nostra portata e l'impatto su tutti i tipi di lavoratori — dal quartier generale al fronte. La nostra missione: far sentire le persone che appartengono e hanno uno scopo. Creare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti sono impegnati e lavorare insieme verso lo stesso obiettivo. Oltre 700 aziende leader si affidano alla nostra soluzione per: 🎯 Migliorare la produttività dei loro team con la nostra piattaforma di esperienza collaborativa basata su AI integrata con le suite collaborative di Google e Microsoft, 🎯 Trasformare i dipendenti in veri ambasciatori della loro azienda, 🎯 Rendere i dipendenti più efficienti e meglio collegati ai loro coetanei e informazioni pertinenti, indipendentemente dalla loro posizione, con gli strumenti e le informazioni di cui hanno bisogno a portata di mano, 🎯 Aiutare le aziende a ridurre il fatturato, accelerare l'imbarco dei dipendenti, collaborare meglio e condividere le conoscenze, e anche migliorare le loro esperienze dei clienti. Con un team di oltre 600 Lumies sparsi in 11 uffici (Lyon, Paris, Lille, Sophia Antipolis, Londra, Barcellona, Amburgo, Austin, Tokyo, Zurigo, Cracovia), sosteniamo grandi imprese in tutto il mondo. Nel corso dell'ultimo anno, abbiamo guidato una fase ambiziosa nel nostro viaggio sotto l'impulso del nostro nuovo azionista Bridgepoint, volto a spingerci a diventare il leader chiaro nel nostro mercato e a brillare in tutto il mondo nel nostro settore. Siamo alla ricerca di individui che sono entusiasti di partecipare attivamente a questa trasformazione. Se questi valori fondamentali suonano come voi: "essere audaci, fare cose incredibili" , "spiegare cosa intendi, fare quello che dici" , "una squadra, stessa missione" , "sempre essere in evoluzione" : applica ora! *Team* Il Account Manager è la gestione delle relazioni di parti uguali, le vendite e la soddisfazione del cliente. Sarete responsabili di possedere un portafoglio di conti, l'esecuzione di contratti di rinnovo, e opportunità di upsell. Crediamo che mantenere i nostri clienti esistenti sia altrettanto importante quanto l'acquisto di nuovi. Questo ruolo gestirà un insieme assegnato di clienti con l'obiettivo di mantenere e aumentare i tassi di rinnovo e stabilire relazioni con un focus sulla ritenzione e l'identificazione delle opportunità di upsell e di espansione. Potrai lavorare con i team di successo del cliente per identificare le opportunità di crescita e fornire informazioni che migliorano i risultati futuri. Non solo si garantisce che i nostri clienti sono impostati per il successo, ma anche massimizzare il fatturato totale. La vostra capacità di articolare chiaramente la nostra proposta di valore, sostenere e rinnovare gli abbonamenti, risolvere i problemi del cliente, e gestire efficacemente il vostro tempo sarà ben ricompensato. *Missioni*
• Possedere il processo di rinnovamento e collaborare con risorse interne (Customer Success, Account Executives, Sales Ops...) per sviluppare strategie complete "win" per i rinnovi
• Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie di negoziazione per i rinnovi di account di medie e grandi dimensioni che massimizzano il valore contrattuale proteggendo e migliorando la fiducia dei clienti
• Identificare i requisiti dei clienti, scoprire i blocchi stradali e dimostrare una forte gestione del conto e capacità commerciali per guidare il rinnovamento alla chiusura in tempo
• Sviluppare modi innovativi per mantenere clienti escalati e fornire loro opzioni di rinnovo valide, tra cui, ma non solo, negoziare i prezzi e/o la durata del contratto
• Identificare opportunità cross-sell/up-sell e farli accadere
• Responsabile per la creazione di moduli di ordine di rinnovo e proposte
• Leverage Salesforce, Planhat & Clari per mantenere una pipeline accurata e preeca st *Skills*
• Esperienza nelle vendite, gestione account o espansione account
• Tedesco nativo e fluente in inglese
• Un minimo di 3+ anni di esperienza lavorativa SaaS rilevante
• Forte acum aziendale e capacità di analizzare i dati per affrontare le situazioni dei clienti
• Ottima capacità di comunicazione/presentazione e capacità di costruire relazioni
• Capacità organizzative e di gestione del tempo
• Self-starter, desideroso di imparare e non paura di cercare competenze di altri intorno a voi per adattare e perfezionare il vostro lavoro. Flessibilità di lavorare in modo indipendente e all'interno di un ambiente di team
• Conoscenza delle ricerche di mercato e negoziazioni *Bonus Points*
• Esperienza in una società ad alta crescita
• Laurea in Economia, Marketing, o simil ar 💡 Perché ti piace lavorare a LumApps Siamo orgogliosi di offrire un ambiente di lavoro in cui le persone si sentono sostenute, valutate e potenziate. Ecco un'occhiata a ciò che offriamo: 🏡 Modello di lavoro ibrido – da 2 a 3 giorni in ufficio 🕒 25 giorni di congedo annuale 🛡️ Piano di schema pensione con 3 opzioni tra cui scegliere 🎉 Afterworks, feste di squadra e feste stagionali Attrezzatura Vogliamo celebrare la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Incoraggiamo le domande da candidati di tutti gli sfondi, identità ed esperienze.

Ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter engagiert sind und gemeinsam auf das gleiche Ziel hinarbeiten. Wenn diese Grundwerte wie Sie klingen: "Sei mutig, tu erstaunliche Dinge" , "Sag, was du meinst, tu, was du sagst" , "Ein Team, dieselbe Mission" , "sei immer in Entwicklung" : bewerben Sie sich jetzt! *Team* Der Account Manager ist zu gleichen Teilen Beziehungsmanagement, Verkauf und Kundenzufriedenheit.  To create an environment where all employees are engaged and work together towards the same goal. Over 700 leading companies trust our solution to:
 🎯 Improve the productivity of their teams with our AI-powered Collaborative Experience Platform integrated with both Google and Microsoft collaborative suites,
 🎯 Transform employees into real ambassadors of their company,
 🎯 Make employees more efficient and better connected to their peers and relevant information, regardless of their location, with the tools and information they need at their fingertips,
 🎯 Help companies reduce turnover, accelerate employee onboarding, better collaborate and share knowledge, and even improve their customer experiences.

We are looking for individuals who are excited to actively participate in this transformation.

 LumApps is on a mission to make every employee feel connected, informed, and empowered to do their best work – whether they’re in an office, on the shop floor, in the field, or on the go.  🎉 Afterworks, team celebrations & seasonal parties

LumApps est maintenant plus qu'une simple plateforme d'expérience de l'employé — c'est un Hub de l'employé doté d'IA qui soutient les entreprises dans leur transformation numérique de la communication, de la collaboration et de l'engagement avec leurs clients, partenaires et surtout leurs employés. Notre plateforme est un leader éprouvé dans ce marché dynamique avec une vision et un produit vraiment uniques. Il a été déployé par des clients de Fortune 500 partout dans le monde et offre des avantages commerciaux significatifs. LumApps est identifié comme un leader dans le quadrant magique de Gartner pour les solutions groupées intranet ainsi que dans Intranets Forrester Wave, et régulièrement sélectionné pour le programme French Tech Next40/120. En 2025, LumApps a renforcé sa position de leader en s'associant avec Beekeeper , pionnier des solutions d'expérience en première ligne. Cette collaboration stratégique élargit notre portée et notre impact pour tous les types de travailleurs, de l'AC à la première ligne. Notre mission : faire sentir aux gens qu'ils appartiennent et ont un but. Créer un environnement où tous les employés sont engagés et travaillent ensemble pour atteindre le même objectif. Plus de 700 grandes entreprises font confiance à notre solution pour : Améliorer la productivité de leurs équipes grâce à notre plateforme d'expérience collaborative intégrée avec Google et Microsoft, Transformer les employés en vrais ambassadeurs de leur entreprise, Rendre les employés plus efficaces et mieux connectés à leurs pairs et aux informations pertinentes, quel que soit leur emplacement, avec les outils et les informations dont ils ont besoin au bout des doigts, Aider les entreprises à réduire le chiffre d'affaires, accélérer le recrutement des employés, mieux collaborer et partager leurs connaissances, et même améliorer leur expérience client. Avec une équipe de plus de 600 Lumies réparties dans 11 bureaux (Lyon, Paris, Lille, Sophia Antipolis, Londres, Barcelone, Hambourg, Austin, Tokyo, Zurich, Cracovie), nous soutenons de grandes entreprises partout dans le monde. Au cours de l'année écoulée, nous avons mené une phase ambitieuse de notre parcours sous l'impulsion de notre nouvel actionnaire Bridgepoint, qui vise à nous pousser à devenir le leader clair de notre marché et à rayonner dans le monde entier. Nous cherchons des personnes qui sont excitées de participer activement à cette transformation. Si ces valeurs fondamentales vous ressemblent : « être audacieux, faire des choses étonnantes » , « dire ce que vous voulez dire, faire ce que vous dites » , « une équipe, même mission » , « toujours évoluer » : appliquez maintenant ! *Équipe* LumApps est en mission de faire en sorte que chaque employé se sente connecté, informé et habilité à faire son meilleur travail – qu'il soit dans un bureau, au magasin, sur le terrain ou en déplacement. Nous sommes en train de construire le premier carrefour des employés de l'IA, aidant les organisations à communiquer, à collaborer et à automatiser le travail afin que les équipes puissent se concentrer sur ce qui compte le plus. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un directeur de produit expérimenté pour diriger une de nos tribus de produits, Communication & Collaboration (C&C), qui est le noyau de la plate-forme LumApps, axée sur la création et la distribution de contenus engageants, la gestion des connaissances et des fonctionnalités de collaboration en temps réel pour des milliers de clients et des millions d'utilisateurs. Ce rôle est essentiel pour façonner la vision et la stratégie de la tribu, conduire l'exécution de la feuille de route et assurer la livraison de la valeur des clients et des entreprises. Vous serez chargé de traduire la stratégie en action, de permettre à vos équipes d'exceller et de nous assurer que nous répondons aux objectifs d'adoption, d'utilisation et de satisfaction. En tant que Directeur de produit, vous serez à la fois stratège et opérateur : définir et maintenir une feuille de route claire, encadrer les responsables de produits, et représenter la voix de nos clients et acheteurs personas à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur de l'entreprise. Vous serez le chef de produit d'une tribu dynamique composée de 4 équipes (CMS, Social, Play, Frontline Comms), gérant directement 3-4 Gestionnaires de produits. Les équipes sont réparties entre nos principaux centres de R-D, Paris, Lyon, Sophia Antipolis, Zurich et Cracovie, ce qui en fait un véritable environnement international et collaboratif. En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires de l'ingénierie, de la conception et d'autres partenaires interfonctionnels, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la conduite de l'alignement, l'habilitation des équipes et l'assurance d'une prestation uniforme à tous les endroits. *Missions*
• Définir la stratégie de tribu & portefeuille: Définir et maintenir une feuille de route de tribu stratégique, informée des données, alignée sur les objectifs de l'entreprise, les besoins de la clientèle, et les tendances du marché; rendre la chose explicite et mesurable.
• Diriger l'exécution entre plusieurs équipes : Assurer l'alignement des feuilles de route au niveau de l'équipe, séquencer les paris, gérer les interdépendances (au sein et entre les tribus) et respecter les engagements.
• Être le personnage Expert en matière et voix externe : agir en tant qu'expert en matière pour les principaux acheteurs (p. ex., les gestionnaires de communication interne et de communication d'entreprise); engager les clients, les perspectives et les équipes de GTM avec un récit convaincant.
• Découverte et validation des champions : institutionnaliser la découverte, l'expérimentation et la prise de décision fondée sur des données probantes (recherche qualitative/quantique, analyse de produits, signaux du marché).
• Diriger et développer les talents de PM: Mentor et développer les gestionnaires de produits; augmenter la barre sur la qualité de décision, l'ordre de priorité, et l'hygiène de l'arriéré/plan de route.
• Résultats et transparence propres : Définir, suivre et communiquer les KPI/OKR pour le domaine (adoption, activation, engagement, satisfaction) et partager régulièrement les progrès et les compromis.
• Alignez les parties prenantes et résolvez les frictions : partenariat avec Engineering, Design, Data, Sales, CS, Marketing et PX; sert de point d'escalade pour résoudre les conflits et garder la livraison débloquée.
• Dirigez l' Agentification des flux de travail de base Communication & Collaboration : concentrez-vous sur les agents d'IA pour la création de contenu, la notation de contenu en temps réel et la réécriture multi-style pour amplifier la qualité et la portée du contenu. Nous vous mesurerons sur la base...
• L'adoption et l'engagement accrus des cas d'utilisation de Communication et Collaboration dans l'ensemble de la clientèle.
• Une feuille de route claire et fondée sur des données qui accélère la croissance de LumApps dans les domaines de communication intranet et en temps réel.
• Forte collaboration inter-équipes et inter-fonctionnelles, assurant que votre tribu fonctionne efficacement, s'harmonise avec les priorités de l'entreprise et influence la stratégie de produit plus large. * Compétences *
• Expérience éprouvée en tant que Directeur Produit, Chef Produit, ou Directeur Produit Senior, dirigeant plusieurs équipes dans un environnement B2B SaaS.
• Un bon équilibre entre la vision stratégique et la capacité d'exécution, vous pouvez élaborer une orientation à long terme, mais aussi assurer la livraison.
• Un succès démontré dans l'échelle des organisations de produits, avec une expérience pluriannuelle de la gestion des particules et de l'influence entre les fonctions.
• L'empathie profonde du client et la capacité d'agir comme un expert de confiance pour les personas acheteurs et les besoins du client.
• Excellentes compétences en gestion des intervenants et en communication, capables d'harmoniser les différentes équipes et priorités.
• Une expérience en matière d'adoption, d'utilisation et de satisfaction de produits mesurables.
• Une bonne compréhension de la collaboration d'entrée sur le marché avec Sales, CS et Marketing.
• Familiarité avec les cadres modernes de découverte de produits (p. ex. habitudes de découverte continues, agile à double voie).
• Expérience et bonne compréhension des domaines de la communication interne, de la gestion des connaissances et de la collaboration en temps réel et utilisation des cas dans les scénarios de bureau et de première ligne, et le paysage concurrentiel
• Compétence professionnelle en anglais (C1 ou équivalent).
• Lancement de fonctionnalités d'IA & expertise en infrastructure : Expérience éprouvée en lançant des fonctionnalités d'IA (p. ex. agents, copilotes basés sur LLM, etc.) et une bonne compréhension de l'infrastructure sous-jacente nécessaire pour les évaluer (p. ex. systèmes RAG, Hubs d'agents et modèles de confiance et de gouvernance d'IA). Points bonus
• Contexte de la stratégie de tarification et d'emballage.
• L'expérience de leadership de discours ou de pensée en tant qu'expert de domaine dans votre domaine de persona d'acheteur.
• La maîtrise des affaires française et/ou allemande. Pourquoi vous allez aimer travailler à LumApps Nous sommes fiers d'offrir un environnement de travail où les gens se sentent soutenus, valorisés et autonomisés. • Remboursement jusqu'à 1000 PLN 26 jours de congé annuel/année et 2 jours de congé en santé mentale par année Les prestations énumérées ci-dessus font partie du régime de rémunération pour contrat de travail.  As a Customer Success Manager, you will own and manage a portfolio of customers and be responsible for their overall success. • Results Orientation: You stay focused on impact; driving adoption, retention, and customer outcomes. You’re solution-oriented and committed to resolving complex issues end-to-end.

• Resourcefulness: You’re creative and pragmatic in finding answers—leveraging internal experts, documentation, and tools to move things forward efficiently (including first experience using AI tools to accelerate your work).

*Bonus Points*

• Experience with discovery and questioning techniques

LumApps is now more than just an Employee Experience Platform — it is an AI-powered Employee Hub that supports companies in their digital transformation of communication, collaboration, and engagement with their customers, partners, and above all their employees.
Our platform is a proven leader in this dynamic market with a truly unique vision and product. It has been deployed by Fortune 500 clients around the world and is delivering meaningful business benefits. LumApps is identified as a leader in Gartner's Magic Quadrant for Intranet Packaged Solutions as well as in Intranets Forrester Wave, and regularly selected for the French Tech Next40/120 program.
✨ In 2025, LumApps strengthened its leadership position by partnering with Beekeeper , a pioneer in frontline employee experience solutions. This strategic collaboration expands our reach and impact across all types of workers — from HQ to the frontline.
Our mission: To make people feel that they belong and have a purpose.
To create an environment where all employees are engaged and work together towards the same goal. Over 700 leading companies trust our solution to:
🎯 Improve the productivity of their teams with our AI-powered Collaborative Experience Platform integrated with both Google and Microsoft collaborative suites,
🎯 Transform employees into real ambassadors of their company,
🎯 Make employees more efficient and better connected to their peers and relevant information, regardless of their location, with the tools and information they need at their fingertips,
🎯 Help companies reduce turnover, accelerate employee onboarding, better collaborate and share knowledge, and even improve their customer experiences.
With a team of over 600 Lumies spread across 11 offices (Lyon, Paris, Lille, Sophia Antipolis, London, Barcelona, Hamburg, Austin, Tokyo, Zurich, Krakow), we support large enterprises all around the world. Over the past year, we have been driving an ambitious phase in our journey under the impulse of our new shareholder Bridgepoint, aimed at propelling us to become the clear leader in our market and shine worldwide in our industry. We are looking for individuals who are excited to actively participate in this transformation.
If these core values sound like you: "be bold, do amazing things" , "say what you mean, do what you say" , "one team, same mission" , "always be evolving" : apply now!

*Team*
As a Customer Success Manager, you will own and manage a portfolio of customers and be responsible for their overall success. Your portfolio of customers will be mostly composed of Mid Market companies (MM), giving you the opportunity to learn from a reasonable number of customers in many different industries as you start your career at Lumapps. You will have at your disposal state-of-the-art technology and playbooks that will help you determine which customers to prioritize for maximum impact. As an ideal candidate you’re resourceful and persuasive, effectively showing customers how to get more value from Lumapps, Beekeeper and Comeen.

*Missions*

• Partner with customers to understand their strategic goals, priorities, and desired business outcomes.

• Work with them to build and execute on a success plan and key performance indicators.

• Manage a portfolio of customers post implementation, focusing on growing adoption, ensuring retention, expansion and satisfaction.

• Be the voice of your customers.

• Leverage our data on customers in your portfolio to determine which customers to prioritize and proactively reach out to address their issues.

• Interact and engage with customers on all levels (incl. VPs and Directors) and different personas (Comms, HR, IT, Operations, Frontline).

• Work closely with your Account Manager counterpart to develop a joint success plan for your customers and identify expansion opportunities.

• Drive accountability for deliverables internally and among customer teams to create a sense of ownership and get things done.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Operations to address your customers’ needs.

*Skills*

• Language skills: Fluent in French and English are a must; Swiss German is a strong plus.

• Curiosity & Discovery: You ask sharp questions, dig into root causes, and enjoy understanding the customer’s context, goals, and constraints. You bring technical curiosity and are eager to continuously learn.

• Communication & Active Listening: You communicate clearly with different stakeholders, actively listen, and can explain complex concepts simply. You translate information and data into actionable insights and next steps.

• Empathy: You understand customer needs and emotions, navigate tough conversations constructively, handle difficult situations, and set expectations with clarity and respect.

• Business Acumen: You understand SaaS business drivers and can connect customer priorities with outcomes, value, and ROI. Experience in Customer Success, Consulting, Project Management, or Account Management in a SaaS environment is a strong plus.

• Drive: You take initiative, are hands-on, and bring a proactive “frontline-first” mentality. You’re energized by helping customers and colleagues succeed.

• Results Orientation: You stay focused on impact; driving adoption, retention, and customer outcomes. You’re solution-oriented and committed to resolving complex issues end-to-end.

• Organization & Planning: You are highly organized and structured, able to manage a customer portfolio, plan effectively, and prioritize time based on customer needs, business goals, and opportunities.

• Resourcefulness: You’re creative and pragmatic in finding answers—leveraging internal experts, documentation, and tools to move things forward efficiently (including first experience using AI tools to accelerate your work).

*Bonus Points*

• Experience in change- and project management

• Experience with discovery and questioning techniques

• Technical understanding of SaaS landscape

• Basic technical understanding of integrations / APIs Experience in conducting in-person or online workshops

💡 Why You’ll Love Working at LumApps
We’re proud to offer a work environment where people feel supported, valued, and empowered. Here’s a peek at what we offer:
🕒 25 days of annual leave
💳 Pension Scheme Plan with 3 options to choose from
🎉 Afterworks, team celebrations & seasonal parties
💻 Equipment

We aim to celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

• 3-4 anni di esperienza in un ruolo di gestione ufficio simile e evento interno.

• Lingue: La fluenza tedesca e professionale di livello nativo in inglese è obbligatoria (sia scritta che parlata).

• Comunicazione: Forte competenze interpersonali con la capacità di interagire con fiducia con gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione.

• Organizzazione: Altamente organizzato, rigoroso e in grado di dare priorità alle attività con calma in un ambiente frenetico.

• Tech Literacy: l'apprendimento confortevole e l'utilizzo di strumenti digitali moderni. La competenza in Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets) è necessaria.

Bella-da-Have:

• Esperienza nell'industria tecnologica o in un ambiente ad alta crescita.

• Fluenza in francese.

• Familiarità con strumenti come Canva, TravelPerk, Spendesk o NetSuite.

Condizioni :

• Contratto: contratto a tempo pieno 80% (da lunedì a giovedì)

• Location & Remote Work: Completamente in loco a Zurigo. Nessun lavoro remoto possibile.

• Orari: dal lunedì al giovedì

Siamo orgogliosi di offrire un ambiente di lavoro in cui le persone si sentono sostenute, valutate e potenziate. Ecco un'occhiata a ciò che offriamo:

🎉 Afterworks, feste di squadra e feste stagionali
Attrezzatura

Vogliamo celebrare la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Incoraggiamo le domande da candidati di tutti gli sfondi, identità ed esperienze.

LumApps is now more than just an Employee Experience Platform — it is an AI-powered Employee Hub that supports companies in their digital transformation of communication, collaboration, and engagement with their customers, partners, and above all their employees.

 To create an environment where all employees are engaged and work together towards the same goal. Over 700 leading companies trust our solution to:
 🎯 Improve the productivity of their teams with our AI-powered Collaborative Experience Platform integrated with both Google and Microsoft collaborative suites,
 🎯 Transform employees into real ambassadors of their company,
 🎯 Make employees more efficient and better connected to their peers and relevant information, regardless of their location, with the tools and information they need at their fingertips,

If these core values sound like you: "be bold, do amazing things" , "say what you mean, do what you say" , "one team, same mission" , "always be evolving" : apply now!
 *Team*
 The Enterprise AI Challenge
 While the market focuses on Generative AI prototypes, the true challenge for global enterprises lies in production and scale. Generic AI models often fail because they lack context and cannot securely access siloed enterprise data like ERPs, HRIS, or legacy systems.
 LumApps AI is a high-velocity initiative focused on solving this "Last Mile Integration" problem. We are the bridge between our core platform and customer value. We don’t just license a platform; we deploy top engineering talent to the front lines to ensure AI becomes a secure, deeply integrated, and scalable force multiplier for the modern workforce.

*Missions*
 As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you are the "tip of the spear" for our most strategic initiative. You will solve hard technical truths on the ground, accelerating the adoption of our core AI technologies: Micro-Apps and Agents.
 You will sit at the intersection of engineering and customer impact, navigating technical constraints to deploy live, ROI-generating AI Agents within rapid cycles. This is a rare opportunity to accelerate your career by working with senior leadership and opening doors toward future roles as an architect, tech lead, or product manager.
 Your 
• Responsibilities
 Strategic Co-Innovation: Embed with customers to map complex data environments and identify high-friction business workflows, such as HR onboarding or IT support.
 Rapid Prototyping & Delivery: Build proof-of-concept AI Agents and integrations using public APIs, webhooks, and LLMs that plan, decide, and act within the LumApps ecosystem.
 Enterprise Integration: Architect the middleware and custom connectors required to bridge LumApps AI with systems like SAP, Workday, or ServiceNow.
 Field Feedback Loop: Act as the vanguard for our Core R&D team. You will identify systemic integration patterns in the field and contribute code (PRs) to harden and evolve our core platform, as well as abstract your custom solutions into scalable, repeatable "Industry Vertical Packs."
 Developer Evangelism: Create "plug-and-play" integration templates, code snippets, and technical articles to showcase best practices and enable our broader ecosystem.

 Educational Background: A degree in Computer Science or Information Technology. We are excited to meet top graduates from leading institutions like ETH Zurich, Ecole Centrale Lyon or similar.
 Get-it-done Mindset: A strong bias for action and the ability to self-prioritize in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
 Full-Stack Fluency: Proficiency in Node.js, TypeScript, Java or Python. You should be comfortable with frontend frameworks like React and backend API design.
 Innovation Curiosity: A passion for emerging tech, specifically Generative AI, RAG architecture, AI Frameworks and Agentic workflows.
 Communication: Full professional proficiency in English with the ability to translate complex technical challenges into clear business outcomes for customers.
 Availability to Travel: Willingness to travel (approximately 2 weeks per quarter) to innovate directly with customers on-site.
 Bonus Points
 Consultant Mindset: Experience working directly with customers, understanding their needs and designing high-value solutions to fulfill their expectations
 Agile Experience: Experience working in Scrum environments.
 Security Knowledge: Understanding of enterprise identity frameworks like OICD, OAuth 2.0 or SAML.
 💡 Why You’ll Love Working at LumApps
 We’re proud to offer a work environment where people feel supported, valued, and empowered. Here’s a peek at what we offer:
 🕒 25 days of annual leave
 💳 Pension Scheme Plan with 3 options to choose from
 🎉 Afterworks, team celebrations & seasonal parties

Ti siederai all'intersezione dell'ingegneria e dell'impatto del cliente, navigando vincoli tecnici per distribuire agenti AI dal vivo, generando ROI entro cicli rapidi. • responsabilità
Co-Innovazione Strategica: Integrare con i clienti per mappare ambienti di dati complessi e identificare flussi di lavoro aziendali ad alta frizione, come l'aggiornamento HR o il supporto IT.
Rapid Prototyping & Delivery: Costruire gli agenti e le integrazioni dell'IA con le API pubbliche, webhooks e LLM che pianificano, decidono e agiscono all'interno dell'ecosistema LumApps.
Enterprise Integration: Architetti i connettori middleware e personalizzati necessari per collegare LumApps AI con sistemi come SAP, Workday o ServiceNow.

Identificherai i modelli di integrazione sistemica nel campo e contribuirai al codice (PR) per indurire ed evolvere la nostra piattaforma di base, così come astratti le tue soluzioni personalizzate in "Pacchetti verticali industriali scalabili e ripetibili".
Sviluppatore Evangelismo: Crea modelli di integrazione "plug-and-play", frammenti di codice e articoli tecnici per mostrare le migliori pratiche e abilitare il nostro ecosistema più ampio.
*Skills*
Sfondo educativo: una laurea in Informatica o tecnologia dell'informazione. Siamo entusiasti di incontrare i migliori laureati di istituzioni leader come ETH Zurich, Ecole Centrale Lyon o simili.
Get-it-done Mindset: Un forte pregiudizio per l'azione e la capacità di auto-prioritizzare in ambienti ambigui e veloci.
Fluenza totale: competenza in Node.js, TypeScript, Java o Python. Dovresti essere a tuo agio con framework frontend come React e backend API design.
Innovation Curiosity: Una passione per la tecnologia emergente, in particolare l'AI Generativa, l'architettura RAG, l'AI Frameworks e i flussi di lavoro Agentic.
Comunicazione: completa competenza professionale in inglese con la capacità di tradurre complesse sfide tecniche in chiari risultati aziendali per i clienti.
Disponibilità per viaggiare: Volontà di viaggiare (circa 2 settimane al trimestre) per innovare direttamente con i clienti in loco.
Punti bonus
Consulente Mindset: Esperienza di lavoro direttamente con i clienti, comprensione delle loro esigenze e progettazione di soluzioni ad alto valore per soddisfare le loro aspettative
Agile Experience: Esperienza di lavoro negli ambienti Scrum.
Conoscenza della sicurezza: comprensione dei framework di identità aziendale come OICD, OAuth 2.0 o SAML.
💡 Perché ti piace lavorare a LumApps
Siamo orgogliosi di offrire un ambiente di lavoro in cui le persone si sentono sostenute, valutate e potenziate. Ecco un'occhiata a ciò che offriamo:
🕒 25 giorni di congedo annuale
💳 Pension Scheme Plan con 3 opzioni tra cui scegliere
🎉 Afterworks, feste di squadra e feste stagionali
Vogliamo celebrare la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Incoraggiamo le domande da candidati di tutti gli sfondi, identità ed esperienze.

LumApps est maintenant plus qu'une simple plateforme d'expérience de l'employé — c'est un Hub de l'employé doté d'IA qui soutient les entreprises dans leur transformation numérique de la communication, de la collaboration et de l'engagement avec leurs clients, partenaires et surtout leurs employés.
Notre plateforme est un leader éprouvé dans ce marché dynamique avec une vision et un produit vraiment uniques. Il a été déployé par des clients de Fortune 500 partout dans le monde et offre des avantages commerciaux significatifs. LumApps est identifié comme un leader dans le quadrant magique de Gartner pour les solutions groupées intranet ainsi que dans Intranets Forrester Wave, et régulièrement sélectionné pour le programme French Tech Next40/120.
En 2025, LumApps a renforcé sa position de leader en s'associant avec Beekeeper , pionnier des solutions d'expérience en première ligne. Cette collaboration stratégique élargit notre portée et notre impact pour tous les types de travailleurs, de l'AC à la première ligne.
Notre mission : faire sentir aux gens qu'ils appartiennent et ont un but.
Créer un environnement où tous les employés sont engagés et travaillent ensemble pour atteindre le même objectif. Plus de 700 grandes entreprises font confiance à notre solution pour :
Améliorer la productivité de leurs équipes grâce à notre plateforme d'expérience collaborative intégrée avec Google et Microsoft,
Transformer les employés en vrais ambassadeurs de leur entreprise,
Rendre les employés plus efficaces et mieux connectés à leurs pairs et aux informations pertinentes, quel que soit leur emplacement, avec les outils et les informations dont ils ont besoin au bout des doigts,
Aider les entreprises à réduire le chiffre d'affaires, accélérer le recrutement des employés, mieux collaborer et partager leurs connaissances, et même améliorer leur expérience client.
Avec une équipe de plus de 600 Lumies réparties dans 11 bureaux (Lyon, Paris, Lille, Sophia Antipolis, Londres, Barcelone, Hambourg, Austin, Tokyo, Zurich, Cracovie), nous soutenons de grandes entreprises partout dans le monde. Au cours de l'année écoulée, nous avons mené une phase ambitieuse de notre parcours sous l'impulsion de notre nouvel actionnaire Bridgepoint, qui vise à nous pousser à devenir le leader clair de notre marché et à rayonner dans le monde entier. Nous cherchons des personnes qui sont excitées de participer activement à cette transformation.

Si ces valeurs fondamentales vous ressemblent : « être audacieux, faire des choses étonnantes » , « dire ce que vous voulez dire, faire ce que vous dites » , « une équipe, même mission » , « toujours évoluer » : appliquez maintenant !
*Équipe*
Le défi de l'IA entreprise
Alors que le marché se concentre sur les prototypes d'IA Generative, le véritable défi pour les entreprises mondiales réside dans la production et l'échelle. Les modèles génériques d'IA échouent souvent parce qu'ils manquent de contexte et ne peuvent accéder en toute sécurité aux données d'entreprise siloed comme les ERP, les HRIS ou les systèmes existants.
LumApps AI est une initiative à grande vitesse axée sur la résolution de ce problème d'intégration du « dernier kilomètre ». Nous sommes le pont entre notre plateforme centrale et la valeur client. Nous ne licencions pas simplement une plate-forme; nous déployons des talents d'ingénierie de premier plan pour assurer que l'IA devienne un multiplicateur de force sécurisé, profondément intégré et évolutive pour la main-d'œuvre moderne.

*Missions*
En tant qu'ingénieur en déploiement avancé (FDE), vous êtes le « bout de la lance » de notre initiative la plus stratégique. Vous allez résoudre des vérités techniques difficiles sur le terrain, accélérant l'adoption de nos technologies d'IA de base : Micro-Apps et Agents.
Vous serez assis à l'intersection de l'ingénierie et de l'impact client, naviguant des contraintes techniques pour déployer des agents AI générateurs de ROI en direct dans des cycles rapides. C'est une occasion rare d'accélérer votre carrière en travaillant avec des cadres supérieurs et en ouvrant des portes vers des rôles futurs en tant qu'architecte, chef de file technologique ou gestionnaire de produits.
Votre
• Responsabilités
